_comment: SHARED delivery settings for the weekly recap email. Decisions locked 2026-09-05; see RESEND_EMAIL_PLAYBOOK.md.
_recipients_note: There is deliberately NO `recipients` or `reply_to` key here. Unlike wc-challenge (one league, one flat list), cf-challenge sends ONE EMAIL PER GROUP: recipients come from each groups/<id>/config.json `managers[].email`, gated by that group's `email_enabled` flag (ARCHITECTURE.md L125). A flat list here would silently cross-post one group's standings to another's table. `manager_id` is the join key; `email` is TODO until Zach supplies each address.
_from_note: `mb4` = 'mustard boy 4'. Domain mustardboy.xyz is already Resend-verified (inherited from wc-challenge, which used recap@). Any local-part at a verified domain works with no new DNS.
_site_base_url_note: Both pages.yml and update-data.yml upload `docs` as the Pages artifact ROOT, so docs/ is served at the URL above - NOT /cf-challenge/docs. This is the base for hero images and the CTA link; get it wrong and every image in the email 404s.
_send_dates_note: UNUSED - kept only as the record of a design that was replaced. wc-challenge listed explicit send dates because its cron ran every 3 hours for a month. Here the SCHEDULE is the cron itself (Sunday 08:00 UTC, .github/workflows/update-data.yml) and the CADENCE is should_send.py's week-freshness check: a group is emailed once per week number, and a new filed column is what opens the gate. should_send.py does not read this key. Delete it, or wire a date gate - but do not add dates here expecting them to restrict anything.
